title: The Carpet
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Pam returns from vacation and reveals her upcoming wedding date with Roy. Meanwhile, Michael discovers a foul smell and stain on his office carpet, which causes discomfort and suspicion among the office staff. Michael suspects the incident is an act of terrorism against the office and initiates, then cancels, a sales contest as a result. Kelly seeks Jim's help to find out if Ryan likes her, while Jim also calls Brenda to ask her out. Michael reflects on his management style and relationships with coworkers, fearing he might become like his former boss Ed Truck. The episode ends with unresolved questions about the carpet incident and the dynamics between characters.
